reporting_packages.dashboard_tab_name_rotates: cosmetic-only first tab cycles through 'Executive Dashboard' / 'Monthly Flash' / 'Management Summary' month to month; never a core statement source, not read by the build.

one_off_files.2026-06: Inventory_and_Deployment_Support_June_2026.xlsx — supplementary inventory reconciliation, not a core statement source; ties to BS Inventory line.

reporting_packages.latest_package_supersedes_note: Each monthly package carries a rolling ~30-month trailing window of Income Statement / Balance Sheet / Cash Flow / Debt & Liquidity actuals. The LATEST package in the folder therefore already spans the model's full history whenever that window reaches back far enough (it does for this borrower: the 2026-06 package covers 2024-01 through 2026-06). Per 'latest/most-consolidated source wins', future refresh builds should re-verify this — pull the latest package first, check its own earliest reported month, and only fall back to stitching multiple packages together if a gap appears (e.g. if the borrower ever shortens the window, or a month is skipped).

sign_conventions.revenue_components_sum_directly_to_net_r: no contra-revenue (returns/discounts) lines present; Net Revenue = SUM of the 6 revenue component lines.
sign_conventions.scheduled_principal_is_negative: Both the Cash Flow tab's 'Scheduled principal payments' and the Debt & Liquidity tab's 'Scheduled Principal' are stored as NEGATIVE numbers (a balance reduction). The model's 'Scheduled Debt Principal Payments' covenant-support row sign-flips this to a positive dollar amount.
sign_conventions.capex_negative_in_cf: Cash Flow tab's 'Capital expenditures' is stored negative (a use of cash); 'Net cash used in investing activities' = that same negative value directly (no further sign flip).

ebitda_bridge.model_row: Income Statement!'Reported EBITDA' = Net Revenue - Cost of Revenue - Operating Expenses, no add-backs on its face
ebitda_bridge.deemed_schedule: none — full-text search of the credit agreement + First Amendment found no deemed/stipulated EBITDA table

covenant_support.cash_interest_expense_source: debt-service-schedule.json covenant_support.monthly[...].cash_interest — SOFR observation is a PLACEHOLDER pinned at 4.33%, not from an actual rate notice; flag on every refresh until a real rate notice is filed.
covenant_support.scheduled_debt_principal_payments_source: OVERRIDE per debt-service-spec.json amortization_base.analyst_decision: sourced from the borrower's own certified Debt & Liquidity tab 'Scheduled Principal' line (0.60%/month declining-balance amortization), sign-flipped positive — NOT from the schedule's flat-base principal figures (engine v1 has no declining-balance support). Re-check this override on every refresh in case a v2 engine or a corrected schedule removes the mismatch.
covenant_support.pre_facility_months_are_zero: Apr 2024 - Dec 2024 predate the credit agreement's Jan 15, 2025 closing; both covenant-support rows are 0 for those months (a contractual fact, not a blank) even though a predecessor debt balance and its own amortization appear in the Balance Sheet / Debt & Liquidity detail for that period.
covenant_support.net_debt_row: Balance Sheet!'Net Debt' carries the Debt & Liquidity tab's own Net Debt figure forward (Ending Debt - Cash), per covenant-spec.json's Net_Debt definition note (the engine's primitive can't express Funded Debt-minus-Cash directly, so this model_line is the bound value).

materiality_threshold.rule: greater of $25,000 or 1% of the line

restatement_history: Zero restatements found across all 27 months / 4 source tabs on the first build (see restatements.json, empty). Borrower's own 2026-06 Close Notes confirm: 'First-and-final 2026-06 package; no restatement or basis change.'

known_gaps.no_net_income_interest_tax_da: Borrower's management accounts stop at Reported EBITDA; these four lines are absent everywhere (IS/BS/CF), by design, not an oversight.
known_gaps.no_customer_level_ar_aging: Only Inventory_Aging files are delivered monthly; no AR aging export exists for this borrower.
known_gaps.no_current_subtotal_on_bs: Balance Sheet has CURRENT ASSETS / NON-CURRENT ASSETS section headers with no Total Current Assets / Total Current Liabilities subtotal rows; none invented.

duplicate_label_warning_accepted: Income Statement carries 'NET REVENUE'/'COST OF REVENUE'/'OPERATING EXPENSES' section headers that normalize to the same key as their own subtotal rows ('Net Revenue'/'Cost of Revenue'/'Operating Expenses'); this mirrors the source file's own structure exactly and validate_model.py's last-wins resolution correctly serves the data-bearing subtotal row. Non-blocking warning, expected on every refresh.
